name: Category I ~Shisenjou no Survivor~
original_name: カテゴリーI ～死線上のサバイバー～
source:
High schoolers, hosts, coders, firefighters...
Ten unique people put their lives on the line in a deadly debate.
Who’ll make it out alive when this game keeps repeating, and what's the truth hidden in the explosion?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2006570/]Steam[/url]]
